structural_groups.description: gross NHE1 and NBC alkalinity supply

structural_test_protocol: One group per worker. Minimise its nonnegative shared resource needed for WT J=1, then cap that resource at this algebraic threshold in both genotypes and maximise KO J. Establish evidence status before accepting any restriction. Derive feasible threshold relations analytically where possible; no grid and no target deficit. These are limiting diagnostics, not measured physiological capacities.
joint_gate: Only if no defensible single change suffices and returned mathematics demonstrates necessity; absent evidence is not justification for joint fitting.
